question: Could you help me find the sellers who excel in the following categories, considering only delivered orders: the seller with the highest number of distinct customer unique IDs, the seller with the highest profit (calculated as price minus freight value), the seller with the highest number of distinct orders, and the seller with the most 5-star ratings? For each category, please provide the seller ID and the corresponding value, labeling each row with a description of the achievement.
sql:
WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        oi.seller_id,
        oi.price,
        oi.freight_value,
        p.product_category_name,
        c.customer_unique_id,
        r.review_score
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN olist_order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) as distinct_customers
    FROM base_data
    GROUP BY product_category_name, seller_id
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        distinct_customers,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY distinct_customers DESC) as rn
    FROM customer_counts
),
profit_data AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        oi.seller_id,
        oi.price,
        oi.freight_value,
        p.product_category_name,
        (oi.price - oi.freight_value) as profit
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
profit_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        SUM(profit) as total_profit
    FROM profit_data
    GROUP BY product_category_name, seller_id
),
ranked_profit AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        total_profit,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY total_profit DESC) as rn
    FROM profit_counts
),
order_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        oi.seller_id,
        p.product_category_name
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_counts_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as distinct_orders
    FROM order_counts
    GROUP BY product_category_name, seller_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        distinct_orders,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY distinct_orders DESC) as rn
    FROM order_counts_agg
),
five_star_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        oi.seller_id,
        p.product_category_name,
        r.review_score
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN olist_order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
five_star_counts_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as five_star_ratings
    FROM five_star_counts
    WHERE review_score = 5
    GROUP BY product_category_name, seller_id
),
ranked_five_star AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        five_star_ratings,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY five_star_ratings DESC) as rn
    FROM five_star_counts_agg
)
SELECT 
    product_category_name,
    seller_id,
    distinct_customers,
    'highest_distinct_customers' as achievement_description
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    product_category_name,
    seller_id,
    total_profit,
    'highest_profit' as achievement_description
FROM ranked_profit
WHERE rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    product_category_name,
    seller_id,
    distinct_orders,
    'highest_distinct_orders' as achievement_description
FROM ranked_orders
WHERE rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    product_category_name,
    seller_id,
    five_star_ratings,
    'most_five_star_ratings' as achievement_description
FROM ranked_five_star
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_category_name, achievement_description
